svg.aria-label: Watch bill. Every commit, on your computer: Secret guard. Stops a commit that adds a key file (like .env or a private key) or a known AWS, GitHub, Slack, Stripe or Google token. Flags changes to files that steer AI tools. Pushes and pull requests to main: CI. Runs your tests on GitHub. In straight-to-main mode it reports after the change lands. Pushes and pull requests to main: Secret scan. Checks every new commit again on GitHub, so a key added in one commit and deleted in the next is still caught. Pushes, pull requests and weekly: CodeQL. For Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby or C# code: finds known security mistakes and lists them in the Security tab. Free on public repositories. Weekly: Dependabot. Suggests newer versions of your libraries and GitHub Actions as pull requests. Every Wednesday: Health check. Re-checks every protection and, when anything is rated WARN or FAIL, opens or updates one issue with the counts and the next thing to fix. You push a version tag: Release. Publishes a GitHub release for that exact commit, only if its checks passed on GitHub. Once you say yes: Branch rule. Stops anyone deleting main or overwriting its history with a force-push. Everything that fits your project is on by default for a solo, straight-to-main setup, except the branch rule, which waits for your yes.
